verdict.rationale: Cactus documents native tool calling through Needle: a decorated function becomes a tool, run() completes the loop, unmatched requests return an empty list, and audio-in to tool-calls-out works in one call. The engine also exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs. Community testing confirms structured tool-call output but reports modest accuracy. That accuracy limits quality; it does not contradict that the capability exists. missing for 10: any evidence of reasoning-parser support in requests, documentation of tool-call parameters on the OpenAI-compatible serving endpoint, reliable accuracy beyond about 10 tools.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests

citations.quote: Decorate a function: the signature gives the argument types, the docstring is the tool description, and run() completes the loop
